name: fix-fishing-reel-hits
about: Issue #32, fishing needs to be harder: a bite takes several hits in the green to land, 2 / 2 / 3 / 4 by fish tier (fishing.reel_hits 0). At the coast with forced tiers (`hwp fishing tier N`, squid bait) the window's own bar is reeled by gl sweepclick reading the marker widget: a 3-star (tier 4) fish takes 4 clicks, tier 1 takes 2 and tier 3 takes 3, each hit logged with the zone's new spot and the marker's speed-up (rising for tier 3; capped for the 3-star fish so a tick's step can't skip its 10 px zone). A miss at the 2nd of 3 hits loses the fish ("fought free"). fishing.reel_hits 1 brings back the single press.
